headline: Anthropic reports Claude-designed binders for four scorpion neurotoxins, without neutralization evidence
summary: Anthropic’s Oct 20 technical report describes an internal Claude Science campaign against five medically relevant scorpion neurotoxins. From an initial prompt and four follow-ups, the system generated 318,484 designs and selected 180; the team added 31 designs for laboratory testing. The authors report that 17 of 211 designs met their binding criteria across four toxins, including two Cn2 binders with single-digit nanomolar affinity or tighter in the reported assays. None of 151 designs targeting multiple toxins met the criteria against more than one. The report and sequence/binding dataset are public. These are author-reported binding results: no neutralization, animal efficacy, matched expert/pipeline baseline, or therapeutic outcome is established.
